name: Diabetes Mellitus

whatIsIt.en: A condition where blood sugar stays too high because the body cannot use insulin properly.
whatIsIt.hi: ऐसी स्थिति जिसमें खून में शुगर ज़्यादा रहती है क्योंकि शरीर इंसुलिन का सही इस्तेमाल नहीं कर पाता।

diagnosis: Blood tests — Fasting glucose, PP glucose, and HbA1c.
treatmentOverview: Lifestyle changes (diet, exercise) + medicines (Metformin etc.) and/or insulin, as prescribed by doctor.
whenUrgent: Confusion, vomiting, very high sugar readings, or unconsciousness — seek urgent medical attention.
questionsForDoctor: मेरी diabetes किस type की है?
मेरा sugar target क्या होना चाहिए?

name: Hypertension (High Blood Pressure)

whatIsIt.en: Blood pressure stays higher than normal, putting strain on the heart and blood vessels.
whatIsIt.hi: ब्लड प्रेशर सामान्य से ज़्यादा रहता है, जिससे दिल और रक्त वाहिकाओं पर दबाव पड़ता है।

diagnosis: Repeated BP readings over time; home monitoring.
treatmentOverview: Lifestyle changes + BP medicines (Amlodipine, Losartan, Telmisartan etc.) as prescribed.
whenUrgent: Very high BP with chest pain, breathlessness, or weakness — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Hypothyroidism (Underactive Thyroid)

whatIsIt.en: The thyroid gland does not make enough thyroid hormone, slowing the body's metabolism.
whatIsIt.hi: थायरॉइड ग्रंथि पर्याप्त थायरॉइड हार्मोन नहीं बनाती, जिससे शरीर की चयापचय गति धीमी हो जाती है।

diagnosis: Blood test — TSH (high) and Free T4 (low).
treatmentOverview: Daily thyroid hormone replacement (Levothyroxine) as prescribed, with regular TSH monitoring.
lifestyle: Take medicine regularly on empty stomach
prevention: Regular checkups if family history or symptoms
whenUrgent: Severe fatigue, confusion, or extreme cold intolerance — seek medical attention.
questionsForDoctor: कितनी बार TSH check कराना होगा?

name: Anemia (Iron Deficiency)

whatIsIt.en: Low hemoglobin in blood, often from iron deficiency, causing reduced oxygen delivery.
whatIsIt.hi: खून में hemoglobin कम, अक्सर आयरन की कमी से, जिससे ऑक्सीजन पहुंचाना कम होता है।

diagnosis: Blood test — Hemoglobin, Ferritin, MCV, iron studies.
treatmentOverview: Iron supplements + diet rich in iron; treat underlying cause as advised by doctor.
whenUrgent: Severe breathlessness, chest pain, or fainting — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Asthma

whatIsIt.en: A lung condition where airways swell and narrow, making breathing difficult.
whatIsIt.hi: फेफड़ों की स्थिति जिसमें श्वास नलियाँ सूजकर संकरी हो जाती हैं, जिससे सांस लेना मुश्किल होता है।

treatmentOverview: Inhalers (reliever + preventer) as prescribed; avoid triggers.
whenUrgent: Severe breathlessness, blue lips, or unable to speak — seek urgent medical attention.
questionsForDoctor: inhaler sahi tarah kaise use करूँ?

name: Dengue Fever

whatIsIt.en: A viral infection spread by Aedes mosquitoes, causing high fever and low platelets.
whatIsIt.hi: एडीज मच्छर से फैलने वाला वायरल इन्फेक्शन, जिससे तेज़ बुखार और platelets कम होते हैं।

diagnosis: Blood test — Dengue NS1 antigen, IgM/IgG antibodies, platelet count.
treatmentOverview: No specific antiviral — supportive care: fluids, paracetamol for fever, rest. Avoid aspirin/ibuprofen.
whenUrgent: Severe stomach pain, bleeding, or persistent vomiting — seek urgent medical attention.
questionsForDoctor: platelets कितनी बार check करानी होगी?

name: Typhoid Fever

whatIsIt.en: A bacterial infection from contaminated food/water, causing prolonged fever.
whatIsIt.hi: दूषित भोजन/पानी से होने वाला बैक्टीरियल इन्फेक्शन, जिससे लंबे समय बुखार रहता है।

diagnosis: Blood test — Widal test, blood culture (most accurate), Typhidot.
treatmentOverview: Antibiotics (as prescribed) + fluids + rest. Complete full antibiotic course.
whenUrgent: High fever not improving, confusion, or severe stomach pain — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Gastritis / Acidity

whatIsIt.en: Inflammation of the stomach lining, often causing acidity and discomfort.
whatIsIt.hi: पेट की परत की सूजन, जिससे अक्सर एसिडिटी और असहजता होती है।

diagnosis: Clinical history; endoscopy if persistent or warning signs.
treatmentOverview: Antacids / PPIs (Pantoprazole, Omeprazole) as prescribed; avoid triggers.
whenUrgent: Black stools, vomiting blood, or severe stomach pain — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)

whatIsIt.en: Infection in the urinary system (bladder, kidneys), usually bacterial.
whatIsIt.hi: मूत्र प्रणाली (bladder, किडनी) में इन्फेक्शन, आमतौर पर बैक्टीरियल।

treatmentOverview: Antibiotics (as prescribed) + plenty of water. Complete full course.
whenUrgent: High fever with back pain or vomiting — seek urgent medical attention (may be kidney infection).

name: Kidney Stones

whatIsIt.en: Hard mineral deposits that form in the kidneys and can cause severe pain.
whatIsIt.hi: किडनी में बनने वाले कठोर खनिज जमाव, जो गंभीर दर्द पैदा कर सकते हैं।

treatmentOverview: Small stones pass with water; larger may need medicines or procedures as advised by doctor.
whenUrgent: Severe pain with fever or unable to pass urine — seek urgent medical attention.
questionsForDoctor: dawa se niklega ya procedure चाहिए?

name: Fatty Liver Disease

whatIsIt.en: Build-up of fat in liver cells, often linked to obesity, diabetes or alcohol.
whatIsIt.hi: लिवर कोशिकाओं में वसा जमा होना, अक्सर मोटापा, डायबिटीज या शराब से जुड़ा।

treatmentOverview: Lifestyle change (weight loss, diet, exercise) is main treatment; no specific medicine.
whenUrgent: Yellow skin/eyes or abdominal swelling — seek medical attention.
questionsForDoctor: क्या वापस ठीक हो सकता है?

name: High Cholesterol (Dyslipidemia)

whatIsIt.en: High levels of fats (LDL, triglycerides) in blood, increasing heart disease risk.
whatIsIt.hi: खून में वसा (LDL, ट्राइग्लिसराइड्स) का बढ़ा स्तर, जिससे दिल की बीमारी का खतरा बढ़ता है।

treatmentOverview: Lifestyle changes + statins (Atorvastatin, Rosuvastatin) as prescribed.
whenUrgent: Chest pain or breathlessness — seek urgent medical attention.

name: PCOS (Polycystic Ovary Syndrome)

whatIsIt.en: A hormonal disorder in women causing irregular periods, excess male hormone, and ovarian cysts.
whatIsIt.hi: महिलाओं में हार्मोनल विकार, जिससे अनियमित माहवारी, अधिक पुरुष हार्मोन और ओवरी में सिस्ट होते हैं।

diagnosis: Ultrasound + hormone tests (FSH, LH, testosterone, insulin).
treatmentOverview: Lifestyle (weight loss) + medicines (Metformin, hormonal) as prescribed.
whenUrgent: Very heavy or prolonged bleeding — seek medical attention.
questionsForDoctor: क्या मैं conceive कर सकती हूँ?

name: Arthritis (Osteoarthritis)

whatIsIt.en: Wear-and-tear of joint cartilage causing pain and stiffness, usually with age.
whatIsIt.hi: जोड़ों की उपास्थि का घिसना, जिससे दर्द और अकड़न होती है, आमतौर पर उम्र के साथ।

warningSigns: Sudden severe joint swelling with fever
treatmentOverview: Pain relief (NSAIDs), physiotherapy, weight management; joint replacement in severe cases.
whenUrgent: Sudden severe joint swelling with fever — seek medical attention (may be infection/gout).

name: COVID-19

whatIsIt.en: Viral respiratory infection caused by SARS-CoV-2.
whatIsIt.hi: SARS-CoV-2 वायरस से होने वाला श्वसन इन्फेक्शन।

treatmentOverview: Supportive care for mild cases; hospital care for severe. Follow doctor's advice.
whenUrgent: Severe breathlessness, chest pain, or low oxygen — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Migraine

whatIsIt.en: A neurological condition causing severe, throbbing headache, often one-sided, with nausea.
whatIsIt.hi: न्यूरोलॉजिकल स्थिति जिसमें गंभीर, धड़कता हुआ सिरदर्द होता है, अक्सर एक तरफ, जी मिचलाने के साथ।

diagnosis: Clinical history; imaging if warning signs.
treatmentOverview: Pain relief (NSAIDs), anti-migraine medicines; avoid triggers as advised by doctor.
whenUrgent: Sudden worst-ever headache, fever with stiff neck, or headache after injury — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Conjunctivitis (Eye Infection)

whatIsIt.en: Inflammation of the eye's outer membrane, causing redness and discharge.
whatIsIt.hi: आँख की बाहरी झिल्ली की सूजन, जिससे लालिमा और पानी/पस आता है।

treatmentOverview: Eye drops (antibiotic if bacterial) as prescribed; avoid touching eyes.
whenUrgent: Vision loss or severe eye pain — seek urgent medical attention.
questionsForDoctor: दूसरों को फैलने से कैसे बचाऊँ?

name: Tuberculosis (TB)

whatIsIt.en: A bacterial infection mainly affecting the lungs, spread through air.
whatIsIt.hi: बैक्टीरियल इन्फेक्शन जो मुख्यतः फेफड़ों को प्रभावित करता है, हवा से फैलता है।

diagnosis: Sputum test, chest X-ray, TB skin/blood test.
treatmentOverview: Long-term multi-drug antibiotic course (DOTS) under supervision — complete full course.
whenUrgent: Coughing blood or severe breathlessness — seek urgent medical attention.
questionsForDoctor: परिवार को क्या जांच करानी चाहिए?

name: Malaria

whatIsIt.en: A parasitic infection spread by Anopheles mosquitoes, causing fever with chills.
whatIsIt.hi: एनोफिलीज मच्छर से फैलने वाला परजीवी इन्फेक्शन, जिससे ठंड लगकर बुखार आता है।

treatmentOverview: Anti-malarial medicines as prescribed; complete full course.
prevention: Prophylaxis if traveling to high-risk areas
whenUrgent: Confusion, jaundice, or breathing difficulty — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Gout

whatIsIt.en: A type of arthritis from high uric acid, causing sudden severe joint pain (often big toe).
whatIsIt.hi: उच्च यूरिक एसिड से होने वाला गठिया, जिससे अचानक गंभीर जोड़ दर्द (अक्सर बड़ा पैर का अंगूठा) होता है।

diagnosis: Blood uric acid + joint fluid analysis.
treatmentOverview: Anti-inflammatory medicines for attack; uric acid-lowering medicines long-term as prescribed.
whenUrgent: Joint pain with fever — seek medical attention.

name: Osteoporosis

whatIsIt.en: Bones become weak and brittle, increasing fracture risk.
whatIsIt.hi: हड्डियाँ कमजोर और भंगुर हो जाती हैं, जिससे टूटने का खतरा बढ़ता है।

treatmentOverview: Calcium + vitamin D supplements, bone-strengthening medicines as prescribed.
whenUrgent: Sudden severe back pain after minor fall — seek medical attention.

name: Allergic Rhinitis (Hay Fever)

whatIsIt.en: Allergic reaction of the nose to allergens like dust, pollen, causing sneezing and runny nose.
whatIsIt.hi: धूल, पराग जैसे एलर्जी कारकों से नाक की एलर्जी, जिससे छींक और नाक बहती है।

diagnosis: Clinical history; allergy testing if needed.
treatmentOverview: Antihistamines (Cetirizine, Levocetirizine), nasal sprays as prescribed.
whenUrgent: Breathing difficulty or severe swelling — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Gastroenteritis (Stomach Flu)

whatIsIt.en: Inflammation of stomach and intestines causing diarrhea, vomiting, often viral.
whatIsIt.hi: पेट और आंतों की सूजन, जिससे दस्त और उल्टी होती है, अक्सर वायरल।

treatmentOverview: Fluids + ORS (oral rehydration) is key; antiemetics if needed. Antibiotics only if bacterial.
whenUrgent: Blood in stool, severe dehydration, or high fever — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Acne

whatIsIt.en: Skin condition with pimples, blackheads and oily skin from clogged pores.
whatIsIt.hi: त्वचा की स्थिति जिसमें पिंपल, ब्लैकहेड्स और तैलीय त्वचा होती है, बंद रोमछिद्रों से।

treatmentOverview: Topical creams, cleansers, sometimes oral antibiotics/isotretinoin as prescribed.
whenUrgent: Severe painful cysts or spreading redness — seek medical attention.

name: Insomnia (Sleep Problems)

whatIsIt.en: Difficulty falling or staying asleep, affecting daily function.
whatIsIt.hi: सोने या सोए रहने में कठिनाई, जिससे दिनचर्या प्रभावित होती है।

diagnosis: Clinical history; sleep study if needed.
treatmentOverview: Sleep hygiene first; medicines only short-term as prescribed.
whenUrgent: Severe sleep loss with depression symptoms — seek medical attention.

name: Iron Deficiency

whatIsIt.en: Low iron stores in the body, which can lead to anemia.
whatIsIt.hi: शरीर में आयरन की कमी, जिससे anemia हो सकता है।

diagnosis: Blood test — Ferritin, serum iron, hemoglobin.
treatmentOverview: Iron supplements + iron-rich diet.
whenUrgent: Severe breathlessness or chest pain — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Vitamin D Deficiency

whatIsIt.en: Low vitamin D levels, affecting bones and immunity.
whatIsIt.hi: विटामिन D का कम स्तर, जो हड्डियों और रोग प्रतिरोधक क्षमता को प्रभावित करता है।

treatmentOverview: Vitamin D supplements (dose as prescribed) + sunlight.
whenUrgent: Severe bone pain or frequent fractures — seek medical attention.

name: Diarrhea

whatIsIt.en: Frequent loose/watery stools, usually from infection or food.
whatIsIt.hi: बार-बार पतला/पानी जैसा मल, आमतौर पर इन्फेक्शन या भोजन से।

treatmentOverview: ORS + fluids is key; medicines only as advised. Antibiotics only if bacterial.
whenUrgent: Blood in stool, severe dehydration, or high fever — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Obesity

whatIsIt.en: Excess body fat that increases risk of diabetes, heart disease and other conditions.
whatIsIt.hi: शरीर में अतिरिक्त वसा, जो डायबिटीज, दिल की बीमारी और अन्य स्थितियों का खतरा बढ़ाता है।

treatmentOverview: Diet + exercise + behavior change; medicines/surgery in selected cases.
whenUrgent: Rapid unexplained weight gain with breathlessness — seek medical attention.

name: Vitamin B12 Deficiency

whatIsIt.en: Low vitamin B12, affecting nerves and red blood cells.
whatIsIt.hi: विटामिन B12 की कमी, जो नसों और लाल रक्त कोशिकाओं को प्रभावित करती है।

diagnosis: Blood test — Vitamin B12, plus MCV.
treatmentOverview: B12 supplements (oral/injections) as prescribed.
whenUrgent: Severe numbness or balance problems — seek medical attention.

name: GERD (Acid Reflux)

whatIsIt.en: Stomach acid flows back into food pipe, causing heartburn.
whatIsIt.hi: पेट का एसिड भोजन नली में वापस आता है, जिससे सीने में जलन होती है।

treatmentOverview: PPIs (Pantoprazole, Omeprazole) + lifestyle changes.
whenUrgent: Difficulty swallowing, vomiting blood, or weight loss — seek medical attention.

name: Constipation

whatIsIt.en: Difficulty passing stool or infrequent bowel movements.
whatIsIt.hi: मल त्यागने में कठिनाई या कम मल त्याग।

treatmentOverview: Fiber, water, exercise; laxatives short-term if needed.
whenUrgent: Blood in stool or severe pain — seek medical attention.

name: Peptic Ulcer

whatIsIt.en: Open sore in stomach or upper intestine lining.
whatIsIt.hi: पेट या आंत की परत में खुला घाव।

treatmentOverview: PPIs + antibiotics (if H. pylori) as prescribed.
whenUrgent: Black stools, vomiting blood, or severe pain — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Hepatitis (Liver Inflammation)

whatIsIt.en: Inflammation of the liver, often from viruses (A, B, C) or alcohol.
whatIsIt.hi: लिवर की सूजन, अक्सर वायरस (A, B, C) या शराब से।

diagnosis: Liver function tests + hepatitis virus tests.
treatmentOverview: Depends on type; supportive care + specific antivirals as prescribed.
whenUrgent: Confusion, bleeding, or severe vomiting — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Pneumonia

whatIsIt.en: Lung infection causing air sacs to fill with fluid.
whatIsIt.hi: फेफड़ों का इन्फेक्शन जिसमें हवा की थैलियाँ तरल से भर जाती हैं।

treatmentOverview: Antibiotics (if bacterial) + rest + fluids.
whenUrgent: Severe breathlessness, blue lips, or confusion — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Bronchitis

whatIsIt.en: Inflammation of bronchial tubes causing cough.
whatIsIt.hi: श्वास नलियों की सूजन जिससे खांसी होती है।

treatmentOverview: Rest, fluids; antibiotics only if bacterial.
whenUrgent: Breathlessness or blood in sputum — seek medical attention.

name: COPD (Chronic Lung Disease)

whatIsIt.en: Long-term lung disease causing breathing difficulty, often from smoking.
whatIsIt.hi: लंबे समय की फेफड़ों की बीमारी, अक्सर धूम्रपान से, जिससे सांस में दिक्कत होती है।

treatmentOverview: Bronchodilators, inhaled steroids, smoking cessation.
whenUrgent: Severe breathlessness or blue lips — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Sinusitis

whatIsIt.en: Inflammation of sinus cavities causing facial pain and congestion.
whatIsIt.hi: साइनस गुहाओं की सूजन जिससे चेहरे में दर्द और नाक बंद होती है।

treatmentOverview: Decongestants, saline, antibiotics if bacterial.
whenUrgent: Vision changes or swelling around eyes — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Tonsillitis

whatIsIt.en: Inflammation of tonsils causing sore throat.
whatIsIt.hi: टॉन्सिल की सूजन जिससे गले में खराश होती है।

treatmentOverview: Pain relief + antibiotics if bacterial.
whenUrgent: Breathing difficulty or unable to swallow — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Common Cold

whatIsIt.en: Viral infection of nose and throat.
whatIsIt.hi: नाक और गले का वायरल इन्फेक्शन।

treatmentOverview: Rest, fluids, symptomatic relief (paracetamol). No antibiotics (viral).
whenUrgent: High fever or severe symptoms — seek medical attention.

name: Influenza (Flu)

whatIsIt.en: Viral respiratory illness, more severe than common cold.
whatIsIt.hi: वायरल श्वसन बीमारी, जुकाम से ज़्यादा गंभीर।

treatmentOverview: Rest, fluids, paracetamol; antiviral if prescribed early.
whenUrgent: Breathlessness or chest pain — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Chickenpox

whatIsIt.en: Viral infection causing itchy rash and fever.
whatIsIt.hi: वायरल इन्फेक्शन जिससे खुजली वाले चकत्ते और बुखार होते हैं।

treatmentOverview: Symptomatic relief, antihistamines for itching; antivirals in some cases.
whenUrgent: Breathing difficulty or confusion — seek urgent medical attention.

name: Scabies

whatIsIt.en: Contagious skin infestation by tiny mites causing intense itching.
whatIsIt.hi: छोटे कीटाणुओं से होने वाला संक्रामक त्वचा रोग जिससे तेज़ खुजली होती है।

treatmentOverview: Scabicide creams (permethrin) + treat all family members.
whenUrgent: Spreading infection or severe crusting — seek medical attention.

name: Eczema (Atopic Dermatitis)

whatIsIt.en: Chronic skin condition causing dry, itchy, inflamed skin.
whatIsIt.hi: पुरानी त्वचा स्थिति जिससे सूखी, खुजली वाली, सूजी त्वचा होती है।

treatmentOverview: Moisturizers + topical steroids as prescribed; avoid triggers.
whenUrgent: Signs of skin infection — seek medical attention.

name: Piles (Hemorrhoids)

whatIsIt.en: Swollen veins in the lower rectum/anus causing pain and bleeding.
whatIsIt.hi: गुदा के निचले हिस्से की सूजी नसें जिससे दर्द और खून आता है।

treatmentOverview: Fiber, sitz bath, creams; surgery in severe cases.
whenUrgent: Heavy bleeding or severe pain — seek medical attention.

name: Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS)

whatIsIt.en: Digestive disorder causing abdominal pain, bloating, and bowel changes.
whatIsIt.hi: पाचन विकार जिससे पेट दर्द, फूलना और मल त्याग में बदलाव होता है।

diagnosis: Clinical (Rome criteria); rule out other causes.
treatmentOverview: Diet modification + antispasmodics + stress management.
whenUrgent: Blood in stool or weight loss — seek medical attention.

name: Appendicitis

whatIsIt.en: Inflammation of the appendix causing severe abdominal pain.
whatIsIt.hi: अपेंडिक्स की सूजन जिससे गंभीर पेट दर्द होता है।

treatmentOverview: Surgery (appendectomy) — usually emergency.
prevention: No specific prevention; high-fiber diet may help
whenUrgent: Severe worsening pain or high fever — seek URGENT medical attention immediately.

name: Depression

whatIsIt.en: Mood disorder causing persistent sadness and loss of interest.
whatIsIt.hi: मूड विकार जिससे लगातार उदासी और रुचि में कमी होती है।

diagnosis: Clinical assessment by mental health professional.
treatmentOverview: Therapy + medicines (antidepressants) as prescribed.
whenUrgent: Suicidal thoughts — seek URGENT help immediately.

name: Anxiety Disorder

whatIsIt.en: Excessive worry and fear affecting daily life.
whatIsIt.hi: अत्यधिक चिंता और डर जो दिनचर्या को प्रभावित करता है।

treatmentOverview: Therapy (CBT) + medicines as prescribed.
whenUrgent: Severe panic or suicidal thoughts — seek urgent help.

name: Viral Conjunctivitis

whatIsIt.en: Viral infection of eye membrane causing redness and watering.
whatIsIt.hi: आँख की झिल्ली का वायरल इन्फेक्शन जिससे लालिमा और पानी आता है।

treatmentOverview: Usually self-limiting; lubricants + hygiene.
whenUrgent: Vision loss or severe pain — seek urgent medical attention.
questionsForDoctor: दूसरों को फैलने से कैसे बचाऊँ?
